args.title: Fix password reset email link to user’s configured PUBLIC_URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently contains a link to 'http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...'. This change updates the link to use the configured PUBLIC_URL environment variable instead of the hardcoded localhost, ensuring that the link directs users to the correct location.
